user_story: As a guest, I want cancelling an already-cancelled booking to return a clear error so that duplicate cancellations are handled.

positive.title: Successfully cancel a booking that was already cancelled
steps: User selects a cancelled booking from the list
User attempts to cancel the booking again
positive.expected_result: The system returns an error message indicating the booking cannot be cancelled again.

negative.title: Attempt to cancel a booking that does not exist
steps: User tries to cancel a booking with an invalid or non-existent booking ID
negative.expected_result: The system returns an error message indicating that the booking does not exist.

edge.title: Cancel an already-cancelled booking multiple times rapidly
steps: User initiates multiple cancellation requests on the same already-cancelled booking in quick succession
edge.expected_result: The system returns an error message for each cancellation attempt after the first, indicating the booking cannot be cancelled again.
